item.description: • A permission or a question from a thread you're not looking at grows out of the title capsule, to be answered there or opened in its thread. Two fingers pushing up, or Esc, fold it back, and a mark on the capsule says it still waits until it's answered. • A long thread opened again after another took the window shows its last lines, where it could come back as blank glass until you scrolled. • With two threads side by side, a long draft in one composer no longer pushes the other thread's transcript up. • A click on a thread's text puts ⌘K, ⌘P, ⌘I or Everything Running away, as a click on empty glass does.
